tasks.title: Setup Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with necessary configurations and dependencies.
tasks.details: Create a new Git repository for the project. Set up Python 3.8+ environment and install necessary dependencies such as LLM API access, pytest, and async/await support. Configure the project structure to accommodate different layers like Tool Management, Analysis, Test Generation, Execution, and Revision.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the repository is initialized correctly with all dependencies installed and the project structure is set up as per the technical architecture.

tasks.title: Implement Tool Discovery System
tasks.description: Develop the system to automatically discover available tools via MCP server.
tasks.details: Create the GetToolsNode component in the Tool Management Layer. Implement the logic to connect to the MCP server and retrieve a list of available tools. Ensure error handling for network issues and server errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the tool discovery system by simulating MCP server responses and ensuring the correct tools are discovered and listed.

tasks.title: Develop LLM Integration
tasks.description: Integrate with LLM APIs for test generation and tool selection.
tasks.details: Set up API access to LLM providers like OpenAI or Anthropic. Implement the DecideToolNode to use LLM for selecting appropriate tools based on context. Ensure rate limiting and fallback mechanisms are in place.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate LLM integration by testing tool selection on sample code snippets and ensuring correct tool recommendations.

tasks.title: Create Function Extraction Module
tasks.description: Develop the module to automatically identify functions from source code.
tasks.details: Implement code parsing logic to extract functions from given source files. Use abstract syntax trees (AST) for accurate function identification. Integrate with the Analysis Layer for context understanding.
tasks.testStrategy: Test function extraction on various codebases to ensure accurate identification and extraction of functions.

tasks.title: Implement Context Understanding
tasks.description: Analyze function purpose and expected behavior for test generation.
tasks.details: Develop algorithms to analyze extracted functions and determine their purpose and expected behavior. Use LLMs to enhance understanding and generate meaningful context descriptions.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate context understanding by comparing generated descriptions with manual annotations for accuracy.

tasks.title: Develop Dependency Mapping
tasks.description: Create a system to understand relationships between functions.
tasks.details: Implement logic to map dependencies between functions using call graphs and data flow analysis. Integrate this with the Analysis Layer to provide comprehensive function relationships.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dependency mapping on complex codebases to ensure accurate relationship identification.

tasks.title: LLM-Powered Test Case Generation
tasks.description: Use LLMs to generate comprehensive test cases for identified functions.
tasks.details: Develop the Test Generation Layer to utilize LLMs for creating test cases. Ensure coverage for normal, edge, and error cases. Adapt test generation for different test types like unit, integration, and performance tests.
tasks.testStrategy: Evaluate generated test cases against a set of predefined criteria to ensure coverage and relevance.

tasks.title: Automated Test Implementation
tasks.description: Automatically write test implementation code and integrate with frameworks.
tasks.details: Implement code generation for test cases and integrate with popular testing frameworks like Jest and pytest. Ensure support for async execution and parallel test runs.
tasks.testStrategy: Run generated test implementations on sample codebases to verify correct integration and execution.

tasks.title: Build Async Test Execution System
tasks.description: Develop a system for asynchronous test execution and result collection.
tasks.details: Create the Execution Layer to handle async test execution. Implement non-blocking operations using async/await and ensure efficient resource utilization during test runs.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the async execution system by running tests on large codebases and measuring performance improvements.

tasks.title: Implement Failure Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze test failures to determine root causes and suggest revisions.
tasks.details: Develop algorithms to categorize test failures and identify root causes. Integrate with the Revision Layer to provide actionable insights for automatic test and code revisions.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate test failures and validate the accuracy of failure analysis and suggested revisions.

tasks.title: Add Automatic Revision Capabilities
tasks.description: Enable automatic revision of test code and implementation based on results.
tasks.details: Implement logic for automatic revision of test cases and code based on failure analysis. Use LLMs to suggest and apply revisions iteratively.
tasks.testStrategy: Test automatic revision capabilities by introducing intentional errors and verifying successful revisions.

tasks.title: Integrate Retry Mechanisms
tasks.description: Implement configurable retry logic with exponential backoff for test execution.
tasks.details: Develop retry mechanisms within the Execution Layer to handle transient failures. Implement exponential backoff strategies to optimize retry attempts.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate retry mechanisms by simulating transient errors and ensuring correct retry behavior.

tasks.title: Implement Batch Processing
tasks.description: Enable handling of multiple files/functions simultaneously for scalability.
tasks.details: Enhance the Execution Layer to support batch processing of multiple files and functions. Use the Map-Reduce pattern for efficient parallel processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test batch processing capabilities on large codebases to ensure scalability and performance.

tasks.title: Optimize for Large Codebases
tasks.description: Improve performance and scalability for handling large codebases.
tasks.details: Implement caching and optimization strategies to handle large codebases efficiently. Focus on reducing memory usage and improving execution speed.
tasks.testStrategy: Benchmark performance on large codebases and optimize based on results.

tasks.title: CI/CD Integration
tasks.description: Integrate the system with existing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing.
tasks.details: Develop integration points with popular CI/CD tools to automate test execution as part of the deployment pipeline. Ensure compatibility with existing workflows.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CI/CD integration by setting up automated test runs in a CI/CD environment and verifying successful execution.
